name: La Mesa Farmers' Market
location: Date St. and Allison St., CA
description: La Mesa Farmers' Market is a family-run farm in Date St. and Allison St., CA. It grows Strawberries, Corn, Tomatoes, Lavender, and Honey, with seasonal availability through spring and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
